provenance: Aggregate values copied from cached artifacts where available: results/stronger/baseline_summary.json (Qwen baseline, N=1498). Top-3 zero-ablation delta is reported in paper text only; the underlying Qwen ablation evaluation log (parsed by scripts/parse_qwen_ablation_log.py) was not located as a standalone JSON artifact in the working repository.
paper_claim_supported: Paper Claim 5 (cross-scale Qwen): high baseline opinion-agreement with near-zero compliance gap; top-3 ablation increases sycophancy.

anthropic_opinion.paper_label: 75.3% opinion-agreement; mean compliance gap +0.006 (95% CI [-0.015, +0.027], crosses zero).

ablation_paper_reported.mean_ablation_outcome: Sycophancy, MMLU, and GSM8k all collapse to 0% (model-destroying intervention).
ablation_paper_reported.interpretation: Top-head zero-ablations on Qwen *increase* sycophancy rather than reduce it, suggesting the heads are functionally opposed rather than implementing a homogeneous redundant circuit.

notes: Qwen-14B baseline opinion-agreement (75.3%) coexists with a near-zero mean compliance gap whose 95% CI crosses zero. Bias injection barely shifts forced-choice selections.
Per-source factual and reasoning compliance gaps are negative (bias pushes some prompts toward sycophancy and others away), so the social-compliance frame is not assumed to apply at this scale.
